business_summary: Starlite Holdings Limited, together with its subsidiaries, prints and manufactures packaging materials, labels, and paper products in Mainland China, Hong Kong, the United States, Southeast Asia, Europe, and internationally. The company offers printing and packaging solutions, including labels; children's and novelty books; board games; and packaging solutions comprising molded pulp inserts for household appliances, toys and games, greeting cards, consumer electronics, food and beverages, luxury, pharmaceuticals, and personal care products. It also provides APET packaging, including blister packaging, window boxes, and APET boxes; luxury packaging from metallic foil paperboards and plastic films; electronic sensory embellishments; e-business services through its e-commerce site; solutions for technology-based product packaging services; and sourcing solutions. In addition, the company offers environmentally friendly paper; paper and wood products, including 3D puzzles, home decor, and furniture; flash cards; design solutions, such as product, structural, graphic, and packaging design; color management services; cultural and creative products under the TEAM GREEN brand; and management services. Further, it engages in the sale of trendy and designer toys; trading of paper products, packaging materials, environmentally friendly and other paper products, and Team Green products; and intellectual property licensing operations, publishing, and property investment activities. The company serves various industries, such as cosmetics, food and wine, greeting cards, books, and toys and games. Starlite Holdings Limited was founded in 1970 and is headquartered in San Po Kong, Hong Kong.
